services.name: Kayak Tours
services.desc: Join us for a beautiful sunset paddle in Friday Harbor among the unique bioluminescent micro flora and fauna of the Salish Sea! We'll head out on the water just as town gets crowded to enjoy the tail end of sunset and then post up for front row seats to the Friday Harbor Fourth of July fireworks with Lopez Island fireworks in the distance. As we launch, we'll kayak among harbor seals, roosting birds, and other wildlife as we wait for both light shows to begin. Bioluminescence is useful for many different organisms in many ways. blurb: Outdoor Odysseys offers guided sea kayak tours in premium tandem kayaks around the San Juan Islands, including wildlife viewing of orcas, seals, and eagles. They provide day tours, multi-day kayak and camping tours, and specialty tours such as night bioluminescence and meditation kayak tours. Their tours include expert guides, meals on multi-day trips, and opportunities for wildlife and nature education.

quotes.author: Jane Orvis
quotes.text: Our 3 day and 2 night adventure with Outdoor Odysseys was a total success. The guide was a pro. It takes skill and courage to get on the water with a bunch of novices. The instruction and paddling was fun and doable. Kayaking is very approachable and fun. We plan to go again next summer. The experience can be summed up as stunning nature, low-key glamping (camping without the work of hauling or setting up or cooking), exercise and plenty of chill.

quotes.author: Kerry Cody
quotes.text: The whole trip was outstanding - even for those of us who had never kayaked before! Our guide Caroline went above and beyond. She patiently coached, taught, and encouraged, and cooked amazing meals, all the while teaching us about the islands, the currents, and the various sea creatures and plant life. I have been recommending this trip, our guide Caroline, and Outdoor Odysseys to my whole family and other friends!!!

quotes.author: Shane M
quotes.text: I have been on two multiday outings. In both trips the staff was professional, knowledgable, and experienced. They exceeded my expectations each time by taking the time to know what each persons goals for the trip were. I highly recommend the Stuart island trip, it is exhausting but well worth the effort!

quotes.author: M
quotes.text: my husband and I went in July, peak orca tracking season. while we never saw any orcas, we had the best time ever! our guide, Keith, was hilarious and a gracious dude. gear was in great shape and we met some really interesting folks. quite the adventure!

quotes.author: Pamela MacPhee
quotes.text: Caroline was a fantastic guide who offered wonderful support on the water, and made fabulous meals for us, taking care of every detail to make sure our trip was incredibly memorable. I recommend Outdoor Odysseys and Caroline without hesitation!

quotes.author: Brian
quotes.text: The OO crew couldn't have been more professional and prepared from the moment they picked us up at Friday Harbor through the launch and landing. It was beyond expectations and worth every penny.
